name: Tenocyte (tendon cell)
short_description: Slim, in-line spindle cell of tendons with thin winglike processes, packed with rough ER and Golgi to mass-produce type I collagen that anchors muscle to bone. Responds to mechanical tension; heals slowly because tendons are poorly vascularised.

textbook.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; single dominant elongated spindle cell centred horizontally, thin winglike processes tapering to fine points among sparse parallel cream collagen bundles, quarter cut-away shows flattened oval nucleus, folded rough ER with ribosome dots, curved Golgi stack, several small mitochondria and fine pink cytoskeletal filaments running into the processes, a small distinct gap-junction contact dot where a wingtip nears a neighbour, muted dusty educational palette with thin clean outlines matching house style, dark charcoal background fills edge-to-edge, no border, no baked text)

sem.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; single stellate cell body with several long thin radiating processes lying on a false-colour ridged collagen-fibril substrate true to tendon ECM texture, warm golden-tan cell against cooler pale-bronze fibre background, correct surface-only SEM detail with no interior organelles, single specimen clearly distinguishable from the background, no text or border; processes read as thin radiating filaments rather than literal flattened sheets, an acceptable SEM stylisation and consistent with the do-not-draw list's allowance for a stellate/triangular cross-section appearance)

3d.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; single elongated translucent cell resting on smooth pale-gold collagen cable strands, natural warm amber tones with distinct blue-violet mitochondria, tan nucleus and reddish Golgi body (not neon/monochrome), soft global illumination and subsurface scattering, cutaway reveals folded rough ER, Golgi, several mitochondria and fine cytoskeletal filaments running the length of the tapering winglike processes, clean seamless background fills edge-to-edge, no border; no distinct gap-junction contact patch is visible in this particular render so that structure is left unlabelled for this style)

watercolor.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; hand-painted naturalist plate, aged paper fills the frame edge-to-edge with a soft dark wash halo directly behind the subject, single elongated spindle cell with fine ink-lined winglike processes reaching toward painted parallel collagen strands, cutaway shows a stippled oval nucleus, curved yellow Golgi, a prominent maroon folded rough-ER ribbon, small red-rod mitochondria, pale blue cytoskeletal filament washes and a tiny ringed gap-junction dot near the right process, no separate sheet/mat/border, no baked text)
